Inflation is a general increase in the price of goods and services over time. It is a measure of the rate at which the general level of prices in an economy is rising, and the corresponding fall in the purchasing power of currency. Inflation is a negative economic phenomenon that can have negative effects on the economy.

There are two common causes of inflation:

1. Demand-Pull Inflation: This occurs when there is an increase in the demand for goods and services in the economy, leading to higher prices. This can happen when people are buying more of a good or service than they planned, or when they are spending more of their income on a good or service than they expected.
